topics.label: Introduction to the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, learning objectives, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream cascades such as Wnt and RTK pathways confer growth signal independence.

topics.label: Differentiation block in leukemia and solid tumors
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how blocks to terminal differentiation impair normal tissue maturation in hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and replicative senescence
topics.groupedBecause: They address how cancer cells overcome intrinsic cellular fail-safes by resisting apoptosis, reactivating telomerase, and disabling p53-mediated stress responses.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explain the mechanisms, tissue patterns, and genetic drivers of altered tumor metabolism.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the requirement, timing, and regulatory balance necessary for vascularizing solid tumors to sustain growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genetics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the multi-step metastatic cascade, including vascular dissemination, biomarker tracking, metastatic inefficiency, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It provides closing remarks summarizing the hallmarks of cancer and concludes the lecture.
